name: Bounded half-plane intersection by angle-sorted deque
definition: For oriented closed half-planes H_i={q:orient(a_i,b_i,q)≥0}, compute P=∩_i H_i by sorting directions and maintaining active boundary lines in a deque. Provisional restricted bounded positive-area case; exact insertion and parallel-line rules require review.
variables: H_i half-plane; a_i,b_i oriented line points; P intersection; orient signed cross product
assumptions: Finite input, bounded positive-area nonempty intersection, robust orientation and line intersection; parallel cases require explicit review.
limitations: O(n log n) target bound depends on angle ordering and linear deque procedure; unbounded, empty and lower-dimensional cases not covered by provisional version.
failure_conditions: Invalid line, incorrect deque pruning or unresolved parallel-line handling.
computation: Sort oriented boundaries by direction, retain tightest same-direction constraints, remove infeasible adjacent intersections at both ends and close the deque; independently review all details.

name: Interval union length by endpoint sweep
definition: For finite closed intervals [l_i,r_i] with l_i≤r_i, sort endpoint coordinates x_j and let c_j count covering intervals on (x_j,x_(j+1)); union length L=Σ_j (x_(j+1)−x_j)[c_j>0].
variables: l_i,r_i endpoints; x_j distinct sorted coordinates; c_j active count; L union length
assumptions: Finite real endpoints, ordered intervals, exact or robust comparisons; zero-width intervals contribute zero.
limitations: O(n log n) sorting and O(n) storage; total length alone does not encode component membership.
failure_conditions: Nonfinite or reversed intervals, incorrect grouping of tied endpoints.
computation: Group all endpoint events at each coordinate, update active count and accumulate the next gap if positive; verify tie conventions independently.
